Subject: Bridge contract smoothing + preliminary scale-trigger proposal

Alyssa —

Thanks again for the conversation last week. Per our call, I put together a short proposal to smooth the FY27 renewal so you can avoid a large up-front invoice while still reserving capacity as you ramp. High-level:

- Three-year structure with front-loaded credits: Year 1 splits across quarters (Q1/Q2 lighter, Q3/Q4 accelerate).
- Quarterly "scale triggers": when consumption crosses pre-agreed token thresholds, additional reserved capacity vests immediately and discounts increase by 5%.
- Co-terming: we’ll align the various FigLeaf teams (AI Platform and Search) onto a single renewal date at the end of Q4 FY27.
- Billing: quarterly invoices with an annual reconciliation/true-up.

I attached v2 of the bridge proposal (PDF) and a short extract of our SOC 2 report that procurement asked for in the prior cycle. If this direction sounds good, I can: (a) update the DocuSign to reflect quarterly invoices and the trigger table, (b) loop in finance for billing terms, and (c) share an amended SLA clause for the co-term.

Next steps: can we lock a decision by 11/15 to hit the Q1 provisioning schedule?

Thanks —
Karthik
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
https://redwood.inference/docs/pricing

Alyssa — thanks, great questions. Answers inline below and I attached a quarter-by-quarter cashflow table.

1) Vesting: triggers are effective immediately when the threshold is crossed in a billing period (i.e., the remainder of that quarter is billed at the new reserved rate). We can add a short grace buffer (48 hours) to account for batch uploads if needed.
2) Auto-renew: we usually default to auto-renew with a 30-day notice; for FigLeaf we can change that to a 60-day opt-out starting in year 2, with a cap on the allowable decrease in committed capacity (no more than 20% YoY without re-negotiation).
3) Payment schedule: attached (FigLeaf_Renewal_Bridge_Proposal_v2.pdf). The first invoice will reflect the applied credit; subsequent quarters are listed with projected token bands.

I've CC'd Monica for procurement coordination and Marcus for the technical SLOs. If procurement wants to propose redlines, send them over and Monica will coordinate. I'll prep a DocuSign that reflects the trigger table and the 60-day opt-out language for review.

Best —
Karthik
